title: Casper and the Confession
author: Jonah Vane
blurb: August Pemberton, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
